acceptance_criteria: During countdown and recording a row under the picture shows two hand symbols lit for the hands seen (as the preview counts them) with German words for a caregiver; the row and the picture's frame are orange without a hand and green with one

Five dots show the seconds of the recording: all lit in the countdown, one goes out each second while recording, without animation; the ticks do not redraw the view or reset the press guard, and no timer is left after the camera stops
A preview whose show throws, or a later start whose createPreview throws, leaves no empty picture box (the NG-44 follow-ups)
Every state of the view still fits 320x480 to 820x1180 without page scroll
goal: A child making a gesture sees, without reading, whether the camera sees its hands and how much time is left.
